profile.headline: Entrepreneur and Career Software Developer
profile.summary:
I graduated with a degree in Management Information Systems from the Eller College of Management at the University of Arizona in May 2013, but have actually been working professionally as a web developer since 2008. In my free time I enjoy writing, video game development, and discussing and engaging in entrepreneurial ventures.

I am currently the senior technical lead for the Education and Public Outreach team at Vera Rubin Observatory - I lead the development efforts of our web visualizations, PR website and citizen science  data pipeline.

company.name: Association of Universities for Research in Astronomy

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
I lead the software development team and effort towards Vera Rubin Observatory's first light/look and beyond. I'm responsible for:

- Architecting the various cloud infrastructure and software stacks to ensure our websites and web apps are globally scalable, performant, and available to an international audience.
- Providing technical and leadership support to the development team, and hiring new dev personnel when needed
- Supporting the broader EPO team by providing technical feasibility analysis and contributing to strategic planning
- Involved in strategic discussions and planning around EPO's mission statement and the governance of the EPO team
- Contributing to codebases along the full stack of EPO's software suite - including backend web, React/Next.js, native cloud, and infrastructure-as-code codebases

positions.title: Senior Backend Web Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for designing, architecting, developing, and supporting the backend and data infrastructure for the Vera Rubin Observatory's Education and Public Outreach program.

I designed, implemented, and maintain:

- All headless CMSs that serve up data to our client apps
- Native cloud functions that serve a variety of purposes, including: GraphQL servers, Cloud Cron jobs for interacting with third-party data sources, a data pipeline/ETL service, JupyterLabs notebooks, and infrastructure-as-code for deployment to K8 clusters
- Manage and administrate Postgres databases, optimizing indexes, analyzing query plans, managing pub/sub relationships, managing read replicas
- All Docker and Docker Compose local development setups for the backend and frontend
- Github Actions CI/CD

I also contribute to the React/Next.js frontend codebases when needed.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Instructor teaching the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js)

positions.title: React Instructor
positions.description:
Taught as an instructor for a full-stack web development "bootcamp" that utilized the MERN stack for students that had little to no prior programming experience.

MongoDB or MySQL
Express.js
React
Node.js

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software to help law enforcement find leads to apprehend criminals using Angular/Node.js and a Java backend.

Created, modified, and maintained a complex, composition-based domain model and database schema.

Integrated with Azure cloud services for geospatial ETL ingestion into a noSQL database to allow for geospatial queries.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Developed with the Microsoft stack (Handlebar.js, C#, SQL Server) to augment and maintain a custom CRM for sales and technicians in the field.

positions.title: Software Developer and Integrator II
positions.description:
I was part of a team that designed and integrated auto insurance quotes, bank services, and a car-buying vendor into one streamlined experience.

Before that, I worked as a developer on a team that designed and built a system for updating and modernizing the way USAA's operational data is transformed into meaningful financials for accounting purposes. I also worked on a team that focused on small UI modifications to USAA's website and mobile site.

Throughout my tenure at USAA, I was an active participant and advocate in the VIP(Volunteer Innovation Program), coding competitions, IT innovation, and various other innovative efforts.

In addition to my responsibilities as a software developer, I was also a part of the college recruiting team for the University of Arizona where I recruited interns and FTE. I spearheaded USAA's involvement with and sponsorship for Hack Arizona as a means of broadening awareness of USAA's IT work force.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
Collaborated on contracts for web design and development jobs for various clients:

Created (sole developer) an inventory management web app that was used by Party City stores throughout Arizona during the Halloween season.

Augmented a golf equipment store's website to allow for shipping labels to automatically generate for new orders.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Consulted business owners on how to effectively manage their tobacco categories.

positions.title: Membership Representative
positions.description:
Implemented and saw through the success of promotional marketing strategies
Worked with senior management while gaining valuable experience analyzing ethical issues
Handled accounts receivable/payable for over 5,000 members

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science in Business Adminstration

projects.title: Automated Regression Testing
projects.description: A three person endeavor to create a means of automated regression testing, that is, automating the testing of modified existing code for retrofitted functionality, to lead developer-driven testing. Essentially, we created a means of testing the code that we write and the code that we modify as-we-go, as opposed to using a full-time tester after-the-fact, as we merge it with production code to ensure there are no adverse impacts.

projects.title: Blogging Facial Detection
projects.description: Developed a web application that detects faces from images uploaded to blog posts and crops the image appropriately in order to generate an accurate thumbnail image.

publications.title: Offshoring in the Field of Civilian Protection: Utilizing the 24 Hour Knowledge Factory to Ensure Full-Time Safety and Security of a City's Population
